samples.summary: Merge drop/re-create + partial-cover refusal logic now exists twice: inline in `moveRangeTo` and in `planPasteMerges`/`applyPasteMerges`
samples.evidence: The change extracts `clearCellsUnderMerge` (the reuse the todo asked for, item 2), but the surrounding orchestration is still duplicated: `moveRangeTo` computes a translated destRange, filters `getMergesIntersecting` with `isRangeInRange` + an own-anchor exclusion, refuses, then deletes/re-creates merges inline (sheet.ts:2600-2714), while `planPasteMerges` (2390-2455) and `applyPasteMerges` (2464-2494) re-express the same rules for paste (own-anchor exclusion via `travelling`, fully-contained check, delete-then-recreate, `rebuildMergeCoverMap`).
